references.title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign adult guidelines — screening context
references.passage: Educational paraphrase: screening supports recognition and assessment. A single test or biomarker cannot establish or exclude sepsis. This demo's research score is not a diagnosis.
references.provenance: SCCM, adult guidelines, 2026; accessed 2026-10-17. Short original educational paraphrase, not a reproduced protocol. Developer-selected for the hackathon; not clinically reviewed. Applies to adult demo records only.

references.title: VitalWatch educational review workflow v1
references.passage: In this simulation, review the recorded values and their timestamps, compare trends and missing observations, document a simulated assessment, and demonstrate routing an alert for review according to a local workflow. Accepting a suggested task records a plan, not completion. These are software demonstration steps, not medical advice.
references.provenance: VitalWatch authors, 2026-10-17, project-owned educational workflow v1. Not a hospital protocol; not clinically reviewed.
